confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately certain; accommodation and cocktail/wine anchors are less certain. Cocktail and wine are set relative to local beer prices because direct knowledge is weaker. July is low season and tourist prices shift, so figures may drift. The FX value comes from web search result summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Southeast Asian tourist-town basis with USD-denominated pricing, benchmarked to Cambodian and Mekong-region tourist destinations, with an upward adjustment for Siem Reap's Angkor-driven premium on accommodation and bars.
